name: Notes
description: Somewhere to put a thought before it goes. The box at the top is always open and always ready, so capturing something takes one keystroke and no decisions — no title, no folder, no file. Notes stack up newest first, grouped under the day they were written; pin one to keep it on top, and any word you start with a # becomes a tag you can filter by later. Editors write, edit, pin and delete; viewers and anonymous visitors read the same stream live. Deliberately not the Document frame: that one is for a page you sit down to write, this one is for the thing you would otherwise text yourself. Notes are the space's table notes.table.jsonl, so they sync with the space and open in any table tool.
